authority_precedence: Existing published authority/generation/configuration controls remain controlling; new thread records are derived binding projections, not competing authority.

CONTROL.role: Versioned policies, schema, authority and root pointers; main commit is publication decision authority.

EVIDENCE.role: Immutable source bytes and storage descriptors; evidence existence is not semantic acceptance.

EVENT.role: Immutable append-only journals of explicitly authorized operations; no historical event invented.

SEMANTIC_STATE.role: Claims and immutable views under a committed state root; in Phase8A all engineering semantics remain legacy inputs.

EXECUTION.role: Bounded caches, queues, runtime profiles, resumable partitions and candidates; never persistent engineering authority.

serialization.record_hash: SHA256 canonical bytes under OFG-EA-MRE3-CANONICAL-V1 excluding only declared top-level self-hash.
serialization.ids: Stable opaque IDs; no silent identity merge/split/rename.
serialization.decimal_rule: Authoritative engineering quantities use engineering_value_v1 string-valued decimals; finite noninteger JSON numbers are rejected.

canonical_contract.unicode_version: 15.0.0; reject unassigned code points under this version; version upgrade requires an explicitly versioned canonical contract, never a silent runtime change.
canonical_contract.line_endings: Canonical bytes have no trailing newline. JSONL segments delimit canonical records with a single LF. Embedded newline characters are escaped as JSON \n; no CRLF conversion of raw evidence.

number_handling.structural_numbers: Only signed integers in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; shortest base-10 ASCII representation, no leading plus/zeros; negative zero parsed as integer zero.
number_handling.non_integer_json_numbers: REJECT_CANONICALIZATION_NONINTEGER_NUMBER; encode authoritative precision-sensitive quantities as engineering_value_v1 string decimals.
number_handling.nonfinite: REJECT_CANONICALIZATION_NONFINITE_NUMBER; NaN and positive/negative Infinity rejected.

canonical_contract.string_escaping: After NFC, reject unpaired surrogates; escape quote/backslash and U+0000..U+001F per JSON. Use \b, \t, \n, \f, \r for those five characters, lowercase \u00xx for other controls. All other scalar values encoded directly in UTF-8; slash not escaped.
canonical_contract.raw_bytes: NFC applies to semantic canonical JSON only. Existing MRE2/source bytes, original filenames and provenance remain exact; never normalize raw source bytes or locator bytes.
canonical_contract.hash_self_exclusion: Exclude only the record-specific declared top-level self-hash field before canonicalization.
canonical_contract.duplicate_json_input_keys: Reject duplicate literal keys and keys colliding after NFC while parsing; never keep last key.

event_semantics.stream_order: Sequence strictly increases within named stream; previous_event_hash links each stream; no invented global cross-stream chronology.
event_semantics.immutability: Never edit/delete accepted events or sealed segments; corrections are new events that reference superseded claims without erasing originals.
event_semantics.replay: Same event_id and same hash is idempotent; same ID/different hash quarantined.
event_semantics.publication: Only committed root-reachable segments constitute authoritative event history; prepared candidate journals are EXECUTION objects.

legacy_compatibility.mre2_codec_and_programs: UNCHANGED; derived outputs cannot overwrite current controlled state.

immutable_delta_returns.acceptance_metadata: Separate master-controlled append-only decision events; worker submission is not acceptance.
immutable_delta_returns.activation_gate: Separate explicit user-authorized activation after infrastructure readback and required thread validation; Phase8A alone does not authorize new C011 handling.
